title: The Only Thing That Bites
subtitle: 化学与实验 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 化学与实验（科学与技术·化学与实验）
meta: 主题语境：化学与实验（科学与技术·化学与实验）　|　核心词汇：acid　|　正文 382 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 acid 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 Mr. Vance kept the ① acid in a cupboard with a glass front and said the bottle was the only thing in the room that could not be replaced. He wrote hydrochloric ② acid on the board in white chalk and said the word acid comes from a word for sharp, and that this is why people use it about remarks as well as liquids.

The ③ acid rain came in 1974 and took the moss off the wall behind the lab, and he measured it for nine years and never once said whom he blamed. There was ④ acid on the stone, he said, meaning the rain, and there was acid in the river by 1981, and he said the ⑤ acid, meaning the thing in the water, was the same acid he had taught in 1972 and nobody had asked him about either.

He put one drop of  acid on a piece of the wall in front of us and waited, and when nothing happened he said that is the ⑥ acid test and that is what a test is for, meaning that most of the time nothing happens and you write it down anyway. He was sixty-one and had been told to stop teaching twice, and he said the  acid in his own throat, meaning the cough, was the only thing he had ever been patient about.

His ⑦ acid remark about the headmaster, which my mother wrote down and which I have never repeated, was the only sentence of his anybody in the town remembered. My mother said an acid tongue is the one thing you cannot take back, and she said it with an acid sort of patience, at sixty-one, in the same kitchen, and I have never decided which of them was the sharper.

I went into the lab in 1996 and the cupboard was empty and the wall behind it had been painted, and the ⑧ acid, meaning the bottle, the moss, the river and the tone in my mother's kitchen, was the only thing in the room I could still see. The acid, I found, was still in the word, which is the only place it has ever lasted; nothing bites, he had said in 1972, unless you put it on something, and he was wrong about that exactly once.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. [化] 酸；酸类物质
B. n. （水中、空气中的）酸性物质；酸性
C. adj. 尖酸的；刻薄的
E. 固定搭配：acid rain 酸雨
F. 固定搭配：the acid test 决定性检验；严峻的考验
G. 固定搭配：an acid remark / tongue 尖刻的话／刻薄的嘴
H. 固定搭配：hydrochloric / sulphuric acid 盐酸／硫酸

items.q: the acid in a cupboard with a glass front
He wrote hydrochloric acid on the board
There was acid on the stone
the acid, meaning the thing in the water
His acid remark about the headmaster
the acid, meaning the bottle, the moss

answers.why: acid 意为“酸、酸类物质”，1972 年他把酸放在一个带玻璃门的柜子里，说那是教室里唯一无法替代的东西。
hydrochloric acid 意为“盐酸”，他用白粉笔把 hydrochloric acid 写在黑板上。
acid rain 意为“酸雨”，1974 年酸雨来了，把实验室后面墙上的苔藓都毁掉了。
acid 意为“酸液、酸剂”，他说石头上有的是酸液，指的就是那场雨。
acid 意为“（水中的）酸性物质”，他说水里的那种酸性和他 1972 年教的是同一种东西。
the acid test 意为“决定性检验、严峻的考验”，什么都没发生时他说这才是检验的意义。
an acid remark 意为“尖刻的话”，他关于校长的那句刻薄话是镇上唯一被人记住的话。
acid 作形容词，意为“尖酸的、刻薄的”，此处兼指瓶里的酸与母亲厨房里那种语气。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1972 年他把酸放在一个带玻璃门的柜子里，说那是教室里唯一无法替代的东西。（acid）
他用白粉笔在黑板上写下 hydrochloric acid 这个词。（hydrochloric acid）
1974 年酸雨来了，把实验室后面墙上的苔藓都毁掉了。（acid rain）
他当着我们的面在墙的一块碎片上滴了一滴酸，然后等着看。（a drop of acid）
他说这就是决定性检验：多数时候什么都不会发生，你照样要记下来。（the acid test）
我母亲说，刻薄的嘴是你唯一收不回来的东西。（an acid tongue）
answers: In 1972 he kept the acid in a cupboard with a glass front and said it was the only thing in the room that could not be replaced.
He wrote hydrochloric acid on the board in white chalk.
The acid rain came in 1974 and took the moss off the wall behind the lab.
He put a drop of acid on a piece of the wall in front of us and waited.
That is the acid test, he said: most of the time nothing happens and you write it down anyway.
My mother said an acid tongue is the one thing you cannot take back.
